providers.product: SambaCloud Free and Developer (separate plan states; not SambaStack/Studio)

currentLain.gateway: Installed per assignment; catalog API-key openai-chat

sources.claim: Six per-response RPM/RPD headers; Free without payment method and Developer with payment method. Llama 3.3 70B Free: 20 RPM, 20 RPD, 200000 TPD; Developer: 240 RPM, 48000 RPD, plus 20M tokens/day across models. Reset is time until reset; format/unit not specified.
Cloud key generation in portal; up to 25 keys/user, new keys visible only once. SambaStack uses separate local credentials.
Inference/model paths and Bearer API key; no account billing or quota reader among the inspected paths.
SDK uses API key authentication; inspected client does not establish a browser/device OAuth login.
Same-origin GET /api/usage?user_name=&start_date=&end_date= with optional model_id and api_key_hash; /api/credits?user_name= and /api/auth:me. No account request made.
UTC month selection and model_wise_usage with input_token, output_token and separate pricing fields.
GET /resources/credits/balance has amount and readAt; UI settling notice, 300s client cache and 5s refresh cooldown are not backend freshness guarantees.
credits[] consumed with credit_value, balance_credit_value, end_date, credit_type; client divides credit values by 100.
POST /api/keys accepts userName, apiKeyName, optional expiresAt; response/session contract not qualified and operation not called.

providers.product: Upstage direct Solar API: signup grant, prepaid credits and PAYG separately; Studio subscription excluded

currentLain.gateway: Installed per assignment; catalog API-key openai-chat

sources.claim: Inspected index contains inference/agent/storage APIs and rate guides; no documented general billing/quota API or OAuth/device login entry.
Request usage contains prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.
RPM/TPM/RPS/PPM differentiated by capability and commitment/legacy tier. Solar Mini 4 Tier 0: 100 RPM and 50000 TPM, published limits rather than observed remaining.
Advertises $10 signup credit, paid PAYG and prepaid; does not establish individual credit grant or expiry.

Organization owns keys, billing and limits. Member can read Org balance/spend/limits but per-key usage only own keys; Owner all keys. Usage UTC filters up to 92 days/CSV. Monthly budget UTC with up to 1s enforcement delay; exhausted credit can charge payment method.

Same-origin /api/console/v3 BFF, credentials same-origin, x-console-request: 1. Org GET spend, promotions, usage-limit, rate-limit, usage/export. Spend month_to_date/period; money amount_decimal.value*10**exp; promotions credit_balance/total_credit/credit_coupons with paid/expiry. Org API key create/reveal path constants also exist. No private endpoint requested.
Official cookbook is an integration/example source; it does not establish a general third-party OAuth login or billing-reader contract.

authOptions.copyFree: Potentially; separate API-key creation/reveal needs qualification

authOptions.permissions: Member read Org balances/spend/limits, per-key usage only own keys. Owner all keys; no monitor-only API key established

nativeMeasurements.money: amount_decimal.value * 10 ** amount_decimal.exp; preserve decimal, do not zero unknown

nativeMeasurements.usageRange: UTC, up to 92 days, paginated plus CSV
nativeMeasurements.freshness: Provider as-of unqualified; client credit asOfIso empty; distinguish fetchedAt from settled spending

sources.claim: Evaluation free/limited, 1000 calls/month; Command A+ trial 20 RPM and Production contact sales. Newer model variants may remain trial-limited even on Production key; A/R/R+/R7B Production table 500 RPM.
Production requires legal/usage acknowledgments and possibly use-case approval; signing in or having a key does not prove approved production entitlement.
Native Chat raw input/output tokens differ from billed_units; Rerank search units and Embed tokens retain native units. Trial usage is free/limited.
Native Chat usage is a separate response contract from installed OpenAI-compatible route.
Installed compatibility API is a subset and cannot be assumed to expose every native billed_units field.
Bearer API key and inference/storage/model endpoints; inspected general public schema has no billing/callquota reader. Connector OAuth belongs to connectors.
Public Python client accepts token/API key; inspected source does not qualify a delegated login for billing and inference.
GET /v1/datasets/usage returns organization_usage bytes for dataset storage, not inference quota.
POST /v1/check-api-key validates key, optionally organization_id/owner_id, without balance or key-plan type; currently under Deprecated navigation.
User sees usage history and manages trial keys; Owner has additional billing/payment privileges. Does not establish a monitor-only IAM key.

POST https://production.api.os.cohere.com/rpc/BlobheartAPI/{method}: CLIAuthBegin returns browserURL/secret, CLIAuthConfirm and CLIAuthCheck token; GetAPIUsage/V2 usages and GetBillingActivity/History activity/history. Bearer transport and API key bootstrap methods exist, not called.
/welcome/auth-cli requires session, reads cliSession query and displays Allow/Deny before CLIAuthConfirm(secret). Actual proprietary pairing candidate; no standard OAuth Device Grant established.
Org/date/pagination usage and quantity/productUnit/total; activity.balanceForMonthlyLimit and organization.balance_limit(_enabled) for budget display, not remaining trial calls.
Historical CLI repository candidate currently returns 404; this is a research limit, not proof login is unavailable.
